data.title: A 3D reconstruction of the magnate's court at Ducové (Kostolec)
data.excerpt: The architects Viktória Kyjovská and Štefan Šuster have created a 3D reconstruction of the hillfort at Ducové of a quality that has no equal in Slovakia, in collaboration with Professor Ruttkay, who carried out the excavations there. You can walk right through the whole magnate's court as it was 1,000 years ago.
data.metaTitle: 3D reconstruction of the Ducové magnate's court
data.metaDescription: The architects V. Kyjovská and Š. Šuster, working with Professor Ruttkay, have created a walk-through 3D reconstruction of the Ducové magnate's court.

children.text: I should like to draw readers' attention to a wonderful project that has no equal in Slovakia — a very high-quality 3D reconstruction of the hillfort at Ducové. Its authors are the architects Viktória Kyjovská and Štefan Šuster, and the project was created in collaboration with Professor Ruttkay, who carried out the excavations of the hillfort. The project therefore has not only great visual value – you can walk right through the whole magnate's court as it was 1,000 years ago – but scholarly value as well. Mrs Kyjovská has provided several images from this project for our website. I recommend, however, that everyone visit the site

itself, where the complete reconstructions and videos can be found. Please also support the author by filling in her questionnaire. I can only hope that we shall soon see reconstructions of this quality for other hillforts in Slovakia.
